defs.def: the first letter of a person's first name （名字的）首字母

ex.s: Created by Salk Fellow Talmo Pereira, SLEAP was initially designed to track animal movement in the lab.
ex.t: SLEAP由萨尔克研究员塔尔莫·佩雷拉创建，最初设计用于在实验室中追踪动物运动。

ex.s: During your initial reading of material, do you ever go back and reread sentences or paragraphs?
ex.t: 在你对材料的初步阅读过程中,你是否曾经回去重新阅读句子或段落?

ex.s: “They come to us thinking vegetables are awful, dirt is awful, insects are awful.” Though some are initially scared of the insects and turned off by the dirt, most are eager to try something new.
ex.t: “他们来找我们时，认为蔬菜很讨厌，泥土很讨厌，昆虫很讨厌。”虽然有些人一开始害怕昆虫、厌恶泥土，但大多数人都渴望尝试新事物。

ex.s: Initially the sugar tax was expected to make £520m a year for the Treasury.
ex.t: 然而，前六个月的数据显示收入将不到这个数字的一半。

ex.s: It would affect his/her initial plans．
ex.t: 这会影响他/她的最初计划．

ex.s: What was the author’s initial purpose of collecting newspaper articles?
ex.t: 作者最初收集报纸文章的目的是什么？

ex.s: Google initially used the data collected from users to target advertising better.
ex.t: 谷歌最初利用从用户处收集的数据来更好地定向投放广告。

ex.s: His initial journey to India opened up the sea route from Western Europe to the east by way of the Cape of Good Hope.
ex.t: 他对印度的最初航行开辟了从西欧经好望角通往东方的海上航线。

ex.s: "The biggest challenge at the initial phase was to persuade people to work for me, which was totally outside my experience.
ex.t: 最初阶段最大的挑战是说服人们为我工作，这完全超出了我的经验。

ex.s: You may not believe it, but that was happened at the initial stage of our group’s research on developing a vaccine for malaria.
ex.t: 你可能不相信，但那发生在我们小组研究开发疟疾疫苗的初始阶段。

ex.s: His father was his teacher initially and he was shocked by the ability of his young son.
ex.t: 他父亲最初是他的老师，他被他年幼儿子的能力震惊了。

ex.s: When they initially did this, Helen thought it was a game.
ex.t: 当他们最初这样做时，海伦以为这是一个游戏。

defs.def: the first letters of all of a person's names （全名的）首字母
